title: Notification checkup
summary: Android only (bipe#823): checks that this phone gets pushes on time and offers a fix for each problem. Phone makers common in Brazil (Xiaomi, Samsung, Motorola) stop background apps, so pushes arrive late. Opens from the row bipe_app_notification_checkup_title in notification-settings. A banner above chat-list points here when a check fails.

id.description: permission: bipe_app_notification_checkup_permission, the system notification permission. channel: bipe_app_notification_checkup_channel, the messages channel of the open account is not blocked. battery: bipe_app_notification_checkup_battery, PowerManager.isIgnoringBatteryOptimizations is true. pusher: bipe_app_notification_checkup_pusher, push-registration has a registration for the open account.

passed.description: true shows bipe_app_notification_checkup_ok; false shows the button bipe_app_notification_checkup_fix.

checks.description: In the order of Check.id. Read again each time the screen shows (back from the system settings too).

lastPush.description: The time of the last push this phone received, any account, shown with bipe_app_notification_checkup_last_push. None: bipe_app_notification_checkup_last_push_none.

maker.description: From Build.MANUFACTURER (Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO are xiaomi). Not other: the help text bipe_app_notification_checkup_help_<maker> and the button bipe_app_notification_checkup_open_app_settings show under the checks.

fix.effect: permission: asks for POST_NOTIFICATIONS when not asked yet, else opens the app's notification settings. channel: opens the settings of the messages channel. battery: opens ACTION_REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS for the app (permission REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS, allowed for messaging apps by Play policy); if the phone has no such screen, ACTION_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATION_SETTINGS. pusher: runs push-registration appBecameActive.

openAppSettings.effect: Opens ACTION_APPLICATION_DETAILS_SETTINGS for the app, where the maker's autostart and battery switches are.

notes: iOS has no screen: iOS has no battery optimisation that stops push.

Banner: in chat-list, above the list, when the permission check or the battery check fails and the person did not close the banner in the last 7 days. It shows bipe_app_notification_checkup_banner with the button bipe_app_notification_checkup_fix (opens this screen) and a close button labelled bipe_app_close.
Default chosen (bipe#823): no test push row. The screen shows the last push time instead, because a test push needs a send route (Sygnal or bipe-api) that does not exist. mz can overrule.
Default chosen (bipe#823): the banner uses the permission and battery checks only, because the app cannot tell reliably that pushes were missed. mz can overrule.
